title: Study of the Sensing Kinetics of G Protein-Coupled Estrogen Receptor Sensors for Common Estrogens and Estrogen Analogs.
authors: Lu, Dingqiang; Wang, Xinqian; Feng, Chunlei; Liu, Danyang; Liu, Yixuan; Liu, Yujiao; Li, Jie; Zhang, Jiayao; Li, Na; Deng, Yujing; Wang, Ke; Ren, Ruijuan; Pang, Guangchang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究G蛋白偶联雌激素受体电化学传感器对雌激素的传感动力学，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Endogenous and exogenous estrogens are widely present in food and food packaging, and high levels of natural estrogens and the misuse or illegal use of synthetic estrogens can lead to endocrine disorders and even cancer in humans. Therefore, it is consequently important to accurately evaluate the presence of food-functional ingredients or toxins with estrogen-like effects. In this study, an electrochemical sensor based on G protein-coupled estrogen receptors (GPERs) was fabricated by self-assembly, modified by double-layered gold nanoparticles, and used to measure the sensing kinetics for five GPER ligands. The interconnected allosteric constants (K(a)) of the sensor for 17beta-estradiol, resveratrol, G-1, G-15, and bisphenol A were 8.90 x 10(-17), 8.35 x 10(-16), 8.00 x 10(-15), 5.01 x 10(-15), and 6.65 x 10(-16) mol/L, respectively. The sensitivity of the sensor for the five ligands followed the order of 17beta-estradiol > bisphenol A > resveratrol > G-15 > G-1. The receptor sensor also demonstrated higher sensor sensitivity for natural estrogens than exogenous estrogens. The results of molecular simulation docking showed that the residues Arg, Glu, His, and Asn of GPER mainly formed hydrogen bonds with -OH, C-O-C, or -NH-. In this study, simulating the intracellular receptor signaling cascade with an electrochemical signal amplification system enabled us to directly measure GPER-ligand interactions and explore the kinetics after the self-assembly of GPERs on a biosensor. This study also provides a novel platform for the accurate functional evaluation of food-functional components and toxins.
abstract_zh: 内源性和外源性雌激素广泛存在于食品及食品包装材料中，高水平的天然雌激素以及合成雌激素的滥用或非法使用可能导致人体内分泌紊乱甚至癌症。因此，准确评估具有雌激素样作用的食品功能成分或毒素的存在显得尤为重要。本研究通过自组装构建了一种基于G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPERs）的电化学传感器，采用双层金纳米颗粒修饰，并用于测量五种GPER配体的传感动力学。该传感器对17β-雌二醇、白藜芦醇、G-1、G-15和双酚A的互联变构常数（K(a)）分别为8.90 x 10(-17)、8.35 x 10(-16)、8.00 x 10(-15)、5.01 x 10(-15)和6.65 x 10(-16) mol/L。传感器对五种配体的灵敏度顺序为17β-雌二醇 > 双酚A > 白藜芦醇 > G-15 > G-1。受体传感器对天然雌激素的灵敏度也高于外源性雌激素。分子模拟对接结果表明，GPER的残基Arg、Glu、His和Asn主要与-OH、C-O-C或-NH-形成氢键。本研究通过电化学信号放大系统模拟细胞内受体信号级联反应，使我们能够直接测量GPER-配体相互作用，并探讨GPERs在生物传感器上自组装后的动力学特性。该研究也为食品功能成分和毒素的准确功能评估提供了一个新型平台。
